minimal_api_design.signature: public.account_terms_current_v1() RETURNS TABLE (manifest_sha256 bytea, revision bigint)
minimal_api_design.body: SELECT h.manifest_sha256,h.revision FROM public.account_terms_head AS h WHERE h.id=1
minimal_api_design.properties: SQL STABLE SECURITY DEFINER; zero arguments; fixed search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp; schema-qualified singleton read. No row locks, writes, Account selector, receipt body or credential data.
minimal_api_design.privileges: Existing nonlogin console_terms_owner requires only SELECT(id,manifest_sha256,revision) on head for this reader. Auth gets EXECUTE only; revoke PUBLIC/business execution, pin exact accepted owner/Auth ACL. No Auth/Business table grants or owner memberships.
minimal_api_design.custody: Root serializes canonical query/generator/generated SQL. One exact collective helper-plus-column-ACL profile must pin routine signature/result/body/owner/config/ACL. Prior fully finalized state becomes certified upgrade input, not new serving state. Reject partial/drifted profiles, preserve legacy fence and immutable-receipt guard/FK grants. Populated upgrade and valid replay require row-preservation evidence.
minimal_api_design.configuration: Reuse optional trusted artifact configuration in existing AuthRestState separate from signing/WebAuthn AuthServices. Retained bytes need neither private key nor Auth DB availability. Current-head transport admission stays at AppConfig/AppState; preserve absent-root modes.
minimal_api_design.artifacts: Keep registered identity independent of file availability; exactly64 lowercase hex; only trusted registered local paths, bounded reads and SHA256/required manifest-item validation.
